title: Accepted Central and Western Huasteca trailing-history-data diagnostics
derivative_note: Sanitized integrated-status derivative. Original immutable intake hash refers to the pre-adoption review artifact, not these derivative bytes.
raw_convention: Exact XML-parsed Android raw/value/display copied unchanged from the author1148, independent1155 and held7 packets; XML-escape once.

rows.english: Unexpected data in the undo cache.
rows.raw: Cati AN Paint quiajoctoc para “Undo” (.rgba): AN Paint quipojqui nochi pixels cati monequi. Pero teipa quipanti seyoc byte.
rows.value: Cati AN Paint quiajoctoc para “Undo” (.rgba): AN Paint quipojqui nochi pixels cati monequi. Pero teipa quipanti seyoc byte.
rows.display: Cati AN Paint quiajoctoc para “Undo” (.rgba): AN Paint quipojqui nochi pixels cati monequi. Pero teipa quipanti seyoc byte.
rows.backtranslation: What AN Paint has stored for “Undo” (.rgba): AN Paint read all the pixels required. But afterward it found another byte.
rows.caller_scope: The sole emitter follows complete reading of all required decompressed pixel bytes in this invocation and observes at least one additional decompressed byte. This is not a general unexpected-data predicate. The null validation pass makes no pixel writes; the second non-null read may already have written pixels before this same final probe.
rows.reviewed_resolution_of_prior_objection: Names the completed required pixel-data read and a subsequently found additional byte, instead of only describing material as extra or unneeded. The entire predicate is bound to the one EOF probe in this caller.
rows.primary_linguistic_reason: The completed reading predicate, total required pixel-data object, and subsequent found-byte predicate together express the exact surplus-data condition. The preceding storage clause and exact Undo anchor identify the internal history payload. This is materially more explicit than the held generic extra/unneeded-material candidate.
unresolved_for_root_adoption: Root adoption/hold release still required. Exact unexpectedness is conveyed by required pixel payload already read, but another byte found, rather than a stand-alone unexpected adjective.
Pixel/byte are technical loans and reading/finding digital data are authored extensions; no native usability claim.
Undo topic is current English fallback, so its exact label dependency must remain guarded.
retained_semantic_limits: Required pixels means the exact payload required by entry.width and entry.height, not user wishes or a claim that artwork was complete.
The byte was observed by the post-payload probe; another byte is an existential observed item, not a claim that exactly one excess byte exists in total.
No assertion that unread bytes remain after the probe. No successful restoration, pixel-setting, preservation, source integrity, repair, deletion or future retry promise.
Own source morphology and relative retained. Digital reading/finding and technical unit nouns are authored extensions.
Undo is an exact fallback action-name anchor used to identify the internal history snapshot. .rgba remains an exact internal suffix; no user-visible path or new filename introduced.
Reading pixels here is reading their required encoded payload. The validation pass need not decode them into integers or set pixels. This wording must not be glossed as a successful restored canvas.
The same .rgba history is used by undo, redo, cancelGesture and fill rollback. The purpose anchor does not assert the user invoked Undo.

conditional_label_dependencies.condition: Re-review quoted topic if localized Undo label changes; .rgba is a fixed internal suffix, not a user-selected path.
